text_block_list.text:
When Мэдзиро Райан hears rumors about
Mejiro
McQueen being in poor
condition, she rushes to
see her friend.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But McQueen ignores Ryan's concerns
and claims
to be in perfect condition. To
prove it, she
challenges Ryan to a
scrimmage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан accepts and then learns
firsthand of
McQueen's overwhelming
aptitude for
long-distance races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She grows impatient upon seeing the
momentum
McQueen has gained toward
the spring Tenno
Sho awaiting them
after the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
